name: apple-design-toolkit
description: Skills for building native macOS apps against Apple's official Figma UI kits — design extraction, single-file SwiftUI app builds, and safe password-free root operations

plugins.name: apple-design-toolkit
plugins.description: Four skills for native Mac development: extract exact control specs from Apple's macOS/iOS UI kits in Figma and map them to SwiftUI; build, sign and ship a real .app from one Swift file with no Xcode project; give an app password-free root operations through a hardened spool-agent pattern; and satisfy policy hooks that gate tool calls without burning a retry on every one.
